Title: Public preview: Azure Digital Twins 3D Scenes Studio

Body.Content:
With a digital twins graph and curated 3D model, your subject matter experts can leverage the Studio’s low-code builder to map the 3D objects to the digital twin and define business logic for a 3D Scene. You can expose the 3D Scene to your end-users by deep-linking into the hosted experience (in the ADT Explorer) or by embedding the 3D viewer component into your custom applications.

To learn more:

  • Check out the 3D Scenes Studio announcement blog
  • Get started with the 3D Scenes Studio quickstart
